newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Two Ukrainian elephants get new mate from Israel.
newsitem.headline: Two Ukrainian elephants get new mate from Israel.

text.p: A Ukrainian zoo has imported a seven-year-old African bull elephant called Nipple from Israel as a mate for its two females in a bid to attract visitors.

Leonid Tsukanov, director of the zoo in the city of Mykolayiv, some 500 km (270 miles) south of the capital Kiev, said the zoo paid $10,000 for Nipple, who arrived on Saturday after a nine-day sea voyage.
"We have two she-elephants and it was clear that they needed a husband. Recently we decided we wanted baby elephants," Tsukanov told Reuters on Sunday.
"It's a real joy to have baby elephants. We hope for more visitors after they are born," he added.
Nipple's new wives are 18-year-old Jilda and 14-year-old Changi, both African elephants.
